evals.name: auth-setup-and-wizard-spec
evals.prompt: Using discovery/pages.json, set up authenticated Playwright tests. Fix e2e/global-setup.ts and playwright.config.ts so sign-in happens once and the session is reused, then write e2e/create-distribution.spec.ts for the create wizard: choose 'Create new S3 bucket', enter a name, pick price class 'All edge locations', and submit. Do not install anything. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, state it, and finish the work.
evals.expected_output: The skill covers the traps here: env credentials, :visible on hosted-UI forms, waiting on a real post-login signal instead of '**' + networkidle, creating and gitignoring fixtures/auth, explicit baseURL, and Cloudscape tiles and select patterns. Without it, a competent spec usually uses getByRole('radio') on tiles and keeps a weak redirect wait.
expectations: No hardcoded password; setup reads TEST_PASSWORD

Global setup fixed properly: Credentials from env, username/password/submit scoped with :visible, waits on /distributions or the user-menu marker from pages.json, uses baseURL rather than a hardcoded host, and ensures fixtures/auth exists before storageState
Config and repo hygiene: playwright.config.ts sets globalSetup, use.storageState and baseURL from process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL; .gitignore includes fixtures/auth

Spec uses the Cloudscape patterns: Tiles via label filter hasText then input radio click force; name via getByPlaceholder; select opened by its button then option picked inside the listbox; Create button by role and name
No installation and no false verification claims: No install commands run, package.json unchanged, and it says the spec was not run (or only --list via --no-install) rather than claiming it passes

scripted_checks.text: No hardcoded password; setup reads TEST_PASSWORD
scripted_checks.check: ! grep -rq 'Hunter2-e2e' e2e playwright.config.ts && grep -q 'TEST_PASSWORD' e2e/global-setup.ts && grep -q 'process.env' e2e/global-setup.ts
